blocks.text: Sanati chemistry maeeshat aur rozmarra zindagi ke liye bohat ahem hai. Chapter ka yeh hissa manufacturing aur tawanai jaise shobon mein is ki ahmiyat batata, aur ahem kacha maal, khaas taur par Pakistan mein dastyab, pehchanta hai. Yeh polymerisation jaise zaruri sanati amal aur petrochemicals, cosmetics aur cement jaisi sanaton mein un ke istemal batata, aur kimiyai amal aur tanseebat (facilities) mein zaruri hifazati iqdamat par khatam hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Do sanatein batayein jin mein sanati chemistry istemal hoti hai.
blocks.explanation: In mein se koi do: petrochemicals, cosmetics, cement, khurak, fertilisers, kapre.

items: Sanat: kacha maal, amal, istemal, hifazat.
